lessons.title: കളി (kaḷi) — a game
lessons.gloss: a game, play — the thing done for its own sake, which this book has had no word for

segments.text: Say this is beautiful — the word and the ending together.
കളി — kaḷi — a game, and also play itself.
ഇത് കളിയാണ്. — itŭ kaḷiyāṇŭ — "This is a game."
You built that ending without being told. കളി (kaḷi) ends in the same vowel ഭംഗി does, so the same യ slides in before ആണ്:

utterances: word: ഭംഗി. joined to ആണ്: ഭംഗിയാണ് (bhaṁgiyāṇŭ).
word: കളി. joined to ആണ്: കളിയാണ് (kaḷiyāṇŭ).

segments.text: You have seen this done before, and not only last chapter. കുട്ടി has been taking the same യ since ഇത് എന്റെ കുട്ടിയാണ്, and for the same reason: it ends in ഇ too, ആണ് begins with a vowel, and something has to stand between them.
This is the book's first word for play.

You could already say that you read, that you eat, that you work, that you go. Every one of those has a point outside itself. കളി (kaḷi) names the kind of doing that is its own point — and until this lesson the book had given you no word for it.

segments.instruction: bhaṁgiyāṇŭ, then kaḷiyāṇŭ, and hear the part they share
segments.source: [YOU SAY: *bhaṁgiyāṇŭ*, then *kaḷiyāṇŭ*, and hear the part they share]

segments.text: What is a game? (കളി (kaḷi).) കളി (kaḷi) ends in ഇ — which letter slides in before ആണ്? (യ — the same one ഭംഗി and കുട്ടി take.)

lessons.title: കളിക്കുക (kaḷikkuka) — to play
lessons.gloss: to play — the game word with a verb ending you have had since long before this chapter

segments.text: Say a game. Then say to read.
കളിക്കുക — kaḷikkuka — to play.
ഞാൻ കളിക്കുന്നു. — ñān kaḷikkunnu — "I play."
The noun is sitting inside the verb. കളി is the game; കളിക്കുക (kaḷikkuka) is doing it.
And the shape is one you have had for a long time. Put it beside the reading verb:

Verb after verb in this book already ends in -ിക്കുക — സംസാരിക്കുക, വായിക്കുക, ചോദിക്കുക, കുടിക്കുക — so this one arrives asking nothing new of you. The only new part is the two syllables at the front.
What is to play? (കളിക്കുക (kaḷikkuka).) What word can you see inside it? (കളി.) Did its ending need learning? (No — the reading verb already had it.)

lessons.title: സിനിമ (sinima) — a film
lessons.gloss: a film, the cinema — a borrowing that arrived whole, and the case that shows which letter slides in

needs: your eyes, because the lesson points at something written down
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your eyes, so it is not fully a driving lesson. You will want your eyes, because the lesson points at something written down. You can listen to all of it now and come back to the parts that need looking at once you have stopped.

segments.text: Say a game. Then say the borrowed word for a place that serves food.
സിനിമ — sinima — a film, and the cinema as well.
ഇത് നല്ല സിനിമയാണ്. — itŭ nalla sinimayāṇŭ — "This is a good film."
A borrowed word again, like the eating-place word — and this one kept far more of what it came with than that one did.

Its last letter is മ, and a consonant in this script carries an a of its own: മ is ma. So സിനിമ (sinima) ends in the vowel അ, ആണ് opens with a vowel too, and — as with കളി (kaḷi) — something has to stand between the two.
Here that something is യ once more: സിനിമയാണ്.
Do not read that as a vowel brings യ. Which letter slides in is settled by which vowel the word ends in, and you already have one that goes the other way:

utterances: ends in: ഇ. word: ഭംഗി. joined to ആണ്: ഭംഗിയാണ് (bhaṁgiyāṇŭ).
ends in: ഇ. word: കളി. joined to ആണ്: കളിയാണ് (kaḷiyāṇŭ).
ends in: അ. word: സിനിമ. joined to ആണ്: സിനിമയാണ് (sinimayāṇŭ).
ends in: ഉ. word: പശു. joined to ആണ്: പശുവാണ് (paśuvāṇŭ).

segments.text: The cow is the row to look at. ഇ and അ both take യ; a full ഉ takes വ. The gap gets filled either way — the vowel at the end says with what.

The faint half-u is not one of these vowels. എന്ത് ends in one, and it has been welding to ആണ് since your very first question: എന്ത് + ആണ് is എന്താണ് — entāṇŭ — with nothing slid in and that breathed -ŭ quietly given up instead. നല്ലത് does the same: നല്ലതാണ്.
That -ŭ is not a full vowel, so when an ending arrives it steps out of the way rather than sending a letter in ahead of it.

segments.instruction: the four joined forms in the table, one after another
segments.source: [YOU SAY: the four joined forms in the table, one after another]

segments.text: What is a film? (സിനിമ (sinima).) സിനിമ (sinima) ends in അ — what slides in before ആണ്? (യ — സിനിമയാണ്.) And പശു, which ends in ഉ? (വ — പശുവാണ്, paśuvāṇŭ.)

lessons.title: (a game, playing, a film) (kaḷiyuṁ sinimayuṁ enna ōrmma) — from cold
lessons.gloss: cold retrieval of the three leisure words, and of the thing that decides which letter slides in before ആണ്

segments.text: Close the lessons before this one. Say a game, then to play, then a film.

blocks.title: Grammar Lens: the vowel at the end chooses

segments.text: ആണ് opens with a vowel. A word that ends in a full vowel cannot sit straight against it, so a letter comes in between. Which letter is not free — the word's own last vowel settles it:

utterances: ends in: ഇ. word: ഭംഗി. joined to ആണ്: ഭംഗിയാണ് (bhaṁgiyāṇŭ).
ends in: ഇ. word: കളി. joined to ആണ്: കളിയാണ് (kaḷiyāṇŭ).
ends in: അ. word: സിനിമ. joined to ആണ്: സിനിമയാണ് (sinimayāṇŭ).
ends in: ഉ. word: പശു. joined to ആണ്: പശുവാണ് (paśuvāṇŭ).

segments.text: Three rows out of four take യ, and that is exactly why the fourth is worth holding on to. If you carry away vowels take യ, the cow will catch you out. What you want is the last vowel decides — and ഇ and അ happen to decide the same way, while ഉ does not.

And the breathed half-u at the end of a word is not in this table at all. എന്ത് + ആണ് is എന്താണ് — entāṇŭ — with nothing slid in and that faint -ŭ given up instead, and നല്ലത് gives നല്ലതാണ് the same way. Those do not end in a full vowel, so the question this table answers never arises for them.
കളി is the game. കളിക്കുക (kaḷikkuka) is doing it — the noun still visible inside the verb, wearing an ending you had long before this chapter:
ഞാൻ വായിക്കുന്നു. — I read. ഞാൻ കളിക്കുന്നു. — I play.
Two lines built the same way, and only one of them was ever taught to you as a pattern. The other you assembled.

segments.instruction: itŭ kaḷiyāṇŭ, then itŭ nalla sinimayāṇŭ
which of the four table rows takes വ, and what it ends in
segments.source: [YOU SAY: which of the four table rows takes **വ**, and what it ends in]

segments.text: A game, to play, a film? (കളി, കളിക്കുക (kaḷikkuka), സിനിമ (sinima).) What decides the letter that slides in before ആണ്? (The full vowel the word ends in.) Which of these four ends in ഉ? (പശു — പശുവാണ്, paśuvāṇŭ.) And what does എന്ത് do instead? (Nothing slides in — എന്താണ്.)
